stem: A logistics company is planning a cross-engine migration and wants the lowest rework risk during cutover while honoring AWS DMS constraints. (Select TWO.)

choices.text: Assume all SQL dialect and data-type behavior carries over unchanged between engines.
Use Amazon Inspector findings as the migration replication channel.
Classify the move as heterogeneous and budget time for schema and query conversion.
Place at least one endpoint on an AWS service when using AWS DMS.
Rely on AWS Shield Advanced policies to transform schemas during cutover.

rationale: Cross-engine moves are heterogeneous and usually need schema and query conversion planning. DMS requires at least one AWS-hosted endpoint. Assuming unchanged SQL and data-type behavior creates migration risk. Inspector and Shield Advanced are security services and do not provide schema or data migration channels.
